[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Talos Drellik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was aligned with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We do a more conceptual sort of soldiering. We fight the dark army of forgetting that threatens our history.|Talos Drellik|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Talos Drellik was the son of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drellik]], who expressed his desire that one of his sons would be trained as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and another would serve in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial military]]. [[Talos Drellik's brother|Talos' brother]] would be taken for training at the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by [[Darth Marr]] of the [[Dark Council]], though he never spoke to his family again. Moff Drellik cursed his Sith son as an "ungrateful little rat", though Talos suspected this was simply his father's way of expressing his grief.

Following his father's wishes, Talos would join the Imperial military, and achieved the rank of lieutenant. However, he never excelled as a soldier; his true passion was history and archeology, leading him to join up with the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]]. To Talos, the Reclamation Service did an invaluable job, preserving Imperial and Sith history against the onslaught of time. He later commented that after the cursing had stopped, his father had warmed to the idea.

Unlike many Reclamation Service officers who are career soldiers with only a passing interest in history, Lieutenant Drellik had thrown himself into his work, studying with experts in the field such as the illustrious Professor [[Auselio Gann]] and galactic historian [[Deravon Wells]].

[[File:Talos_Drellik.png|thumb|right|200px|Talok Drellik on Hoth]]
In [[3642 BBY]], Talos was stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Reclamation Service Hoth expedition|searching for Sith ruins]]. While he was searching for the ruins in [[The Bitter End]], he was approached by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who came to Hoth in search of a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] named [[Horak-mul]]. Talos provided assistance to Kallig in locating Horak-Mul's resting place. Afterwards, he resigned from the Reclamation Service to follow Kallig, serving faithfully even when his Master ran afoul of [[Darth Thanaton]] and eventually ascended to the [[Dark Council]].

During Nox's travels to Rishi, Talos accompanied his lord during their visit to Lord Veijel, a local researcher on ancient alien technologies due to his experience as an archaeologist. When the Sith Lord stumbled upon machines that extended their lifespan and could potentially grant them eternal life, he advised against pursuing immortality, citing it as the downfall of many Sith, including Nox's former master [[Darth Zash]].

Around [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> six years after Darth Nox disappeared in the wake of the [[Eternal Empire conquest|invasion]] by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]], Talos had returned to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to [[Reclamation Service Yavin 4 expedition|study]] the [[Temple of Sacrifice]], where the artifact that [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] had intended to use to resurrect [[Tenebrae|the Emperor]] had been held. The Hutt scientist [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]], who had joined an [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against Zakuul, recognized the necessity of having an expert in archaeology and Force-powered technology, which was used extensively by the Eternal Empire; thus, he requested that [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]], the leader of the Alliance, travel to Yavin to recruit Talos for the cause. After he and the Outlander were able to collect a number of ancient artifacts connected to the temple, Talos agreed to travel with the Outlander to [[Odessen]] and join the Alliance.<ref name="TOR:FPWK" />

Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref>{{TOR_updates|7.1}}</ref> following the [[Mission to Elom|capture]] of [[Darth Malgus]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], Talos joined the archeological team excavating the ruins of the [[Temple of Nul]]. During his time on the site, Talos began to suspect that the temple wasn't as isolated as initially believed, having found several artifacts bearing striking similarities to relics he had uncovered on other worlds far from Elom. When the temple was revisited by the Alliance Commander, Talos relayed his findings and promised that once the artifacts were thoroughly documented, he would proceed with a full investigations into these connections, speculating it would draw out a map of other locations Malgus may have targeted and ransacked.<ref name="DD">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Digging Deeper|Elom}}</ref>

By [[3623 BBY]],<ref>{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> Talos had managed to discover [[Darth Nul]]'s [[Darth Nul's Laboratory|laboratory]] in a previous inaccessible section of the temple as well as an antiquated lab assistant droid that could access it. Talos then traveled to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to meet with the Commander in hopes of locating a dealer for a replacement part. Unfortunately, the store he designated had been temporarily closed by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and another sign suggesting going to the store's rival, [[Bellym Karr]], who just so happened to have the part they needed. Talos and the Commander then returned to Elom, where he fitted the part, which he noted was modified with an uplink device, into Nul's droid, reacting it.<ref name="Library">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Library of Nul|Elom}}</ref>

Descending into the temple, Talos and his allies came to the door to Nul's lab. Talos speculated that the droid was awaiting a passcode or "resonance frequency". Just then, the Commander pulled out [[Darth Nul's holocron]], after which the door opened. As Talos took in the architectural marvel of the inner chamber, the Commander followed the droid and discovered three datascrolls in passing Nul's trials and plugged them into the wall sockets, each playing a holorecording of Darth Nul. The droid then plugged itself into the center console, much to Talos' confusion, before the Commander suggested placing the holocron into the droid's slot. A final holorecording then began to play, revealing that the Sith Emperor had discovered her true plans to awaken the Force in others a reality. Suddenly, the uplink device was activated remotely, transmitting data from the droid to an unknown party. Talos tried to shut it down but failed, forcing his allies to destroy the droid, in spite of his warnings that the holocron could be destroyed. This accidentally triggered Nul's security droids, forcing the party to fight them off. In the aftermath, the Commander recovered the holocron, much to Talos' relief. He then recommended sending the holocron back to Odessen, as they had a mountain of data to sort through.<ref name="Library" />

Before the [[Battle of Khar Shian]], Talos compiled a dossier entitled "''[[Khar Shian Threat Assessment]]''"<ref name="KSCodex0">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Khar Shian}}</ref> to prepare Alliance forces for what to expect in [[Naga Sadow's fortress]] on [[Khar Shian]]<ref name="KSCodex1">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Naga Sadow's Fortress}}</ref>, where he discussed the ancient [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] and his experiments on his [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors<ref name="KSCodex2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Naga Sadow's Monstrosities}}</ref>, as well as his exceptional talent for [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]].<ref name="KSCodex3">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Naga Sadow's Alchemy}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Talos Drellik is a character featured in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He can be first encountered in the [[Sith Inquisitor]] class story and can be recruited as a companion. He is voiced by [[Edward Hibbert]].

With high approval, Talos will eventually swear a traditional oath of loyalty to the Inquisitor, citing evidence of similar oaths from the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]].

If the Outlander is an Inquisitor and has high approval with Talos, the archaeologist will express delight that his master is still alive. The Dark Lord then has the option of simply ordering Talos to return with them to Odessen rather than go through the quest.<ref name="TOR:FPWK" /> If the Eternal Alliance sides with the Republic against the Sith Empire, Talos will send the player a message entitled ''Deepest Regrets'', stating his intent to return to the Imperial Reclamation Service.<ref name="Deepest Regrets">{{TORcite|type=message|Deepest Regrets|Talos Drellik}}</ref> For reasons unknown, this appears to have been retconned, as he appears throughout the expansion, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', as a continued member of the Alliance in both Republic and Imperial storylines, with no mention of his statements in ''Deepest Regrets'' whatsoever.<ref name="DD" />

If the player is an Inquisitor, they can have unique dialogue with Talos when he accompanies [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Barden Golah]]'s investigation in the ruins of the [[Temple of Nul]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]].<ref name="DD" />
